description: List images in a dataset by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI with optional filtering.

classIds.description: Class IDs to filter by. An empty array is treated as no filter (all images match), not as a filter that excludes everything.

dataset.description: Dataset ref by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI.

split.description: Dataset split to filter by, for example train, val, or test.

name: dataset_images_list
